Seagate.next_catalyst: TWO STRUCTURAL OPTION VALUES MANAGEMENT FLAGGED FOR HDD - KV CACHE TIERING AND NEOCLOUD-OWNED STORAGE. On KV cache: between cold storage (HDD) and the running application (NAND) sits a warm-storage tier with several sub-tiers, and 'for sure there are some tiers inside KV cache that can use hard disk drive' - the only place where NAND and HDD overlap. Seagate does not need a flash partner for it, only to meet the performance requirement of the relevant tier. On neoclouds: today they run compute against storage that physically sits in the public cloud, so Seagate sells the same drives to the same public-cloud customers; if neoclouds start serving their own customers they 'cannot access the public cloud storage anymore' and will need their own storage, shifting some of that volume directly to neoclouds - positive for customer diversification, roughly neutral on volume.

Flex.backlog_or_b2b: EPC'S 2027 IS ALREADY BOOKED, AND A JULY GRID EVENT IS PULLING DEMAND FORWARD (Chris): asked what drives EPC's growth, 'It is all pinned to the data centers. It is all pinned to some of those regulatory requirements that are coming. There is also some tailwinds from bans on foreign-produced product in the critical infrastructure here in the U.S. EPC is all U.S.-based production, so that plays in very well.' Asked about visibility: 'Most of that business is booked today' and 'Really good backlog for 2027.' A specific catalyst was named: 'There was a pretty significant power disturbance in Northern Virginia back in the month of July, and that is driving more utilities to demand this type of technology in the data center.' eMemory.guidance: Director of Finance Joseph Hsia: royalty revenue is expected to accelerate in Q3 and the second half of 2026 - several advanced-node products, including ADAS, AI accelerators, SSDs and networking, have begun entering mass production, and foundry wafer prices are gradually increasing. Chairman Charles Hsu: licensing will continue its strong momentum; royalty growth is expected to accelerate on higher ASP from new advanced-node applications, new application ramps, an expanding PUF royalty contribution and a growing mix of higher-royalty-rate MTP applications.
eMemory.supply_status: Director of Finance Joseph Hsia: Q2 royalty corresponds to foundry production in Q1, when mature-node foundry capacity utilization remained at a relatively low level and some customers went through seasonal inventory adjustment; from Q2 overall foundry capacity utilization began to improve.
eMemory.next_catalyst: Chairman Charles Hsu: 1T Flash (NeoFlash / Logic Flash) is in platform development and verification with several foundry partners, each progressing according to plan; customers may begin mass production next year. Standalone development focuses first on NOR Flash; after foundry partners bring standalone NOR Flash into mass production, eMemory may extend 1T Flash into a NAND Flash architecture.
